**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
The technique of mapping quantum reservoir circuits onto noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware while accounting for qubit connectivity and gate error rates. Critical for deploying quantum reservoir computing within TCC's interconnect fabric, where physical topology constraints directly affect computational fidelity.
